summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for ProSync CRM (dual-area energy/network). 15/15 pytest backend tests passed. Frontend login flow works, tab navigation works across Home/Contatti/Calendario/Report/Profilo, backend↔frontend integration verified (settings customization visible on Home cards after PUT /api/settings).

minor.issue: Uses HTTPException with detail 'Google auth fallita' on invalid session; endpoint reachable, real Emergent OAuth flow not exercised per instructions.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID attributes on email input, password input, submit button and Google login button. Only 'Accedi' text is present (which collides with the tab label + 'Accedi con Google' - 3 matches), making automation and future test stability brittle.

issues: Deprecation console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' - non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Add testID props to /app/frontend/app/login.tsx: email-input (TextInput), password-input (TextInput), login-button (submit TouchableOpacity), google-login-button, and to the Accedi/Registrati tab toggle buttons (login-tab, register-tab) to disambiguate the 3 'Accedi' text matches.
Fix 'shadow*' deprecated style warnings by migrating to boxShadow (React Native Web).
(Optional) Add testIDs to tab bar items (tab-home, tab-contatti, tab-calendario, tab-report, tab-profilo) for robust nav testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projections/strip_id — good.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev value if env not set — acceptable for MVP but flag for prod.
server.py is ~680 lines; still manageable but approaching the 700-line threshold for a modular split (routers per resource).
Callbacks day filter parses YYYY-MM-DD as UTC only — may misalign with user local timezone; consider tz-aware handling.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all core flows verified; only missing login testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Test data created via API is prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up in fixtures. One residual contact 'TEST_Luca Rossi' may briefly appear during runs but is deleted in fixture teardown. Settings were updated to 'Consulente Test'/'Networker Test' colors #AA1111/#1122AA — main agent may want to reset defaults if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend base URL = https://consulente-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test@dalpastro.it / Test1234!). Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_crm_api.py covers auth, settings, contacts (CRUD+notes+files), appointments (CRUD+reschedule+done+outcome_tags), callbacks (with day filter), reports (dual-area), google-session endpoint reachability. Login submit button is the 2nd of three 'Accedi' exact-text matches (indexes: 0=tab, 1=submit, 2='Accedi con Google'). Impostazioni/Profilo screen already has testIDs (settings-energy-title, settings-network-title, settings-save, logout-btn, energy-color-*, network-color-*).
rca_of_issue: No functional issues — only observability/testability gap on login screen due to missing testIDs. Deprecation shadow* warnings are cosmetic React Native Web migration items.
